_about: WOD library for the trainer console: CrossFit Open workouts 2011–2025, benchmark Girls, Hero WODs and tests. Loads are Rx men/women in kg. score is how a leaderboard ranks it (time, reps, load, rounds_reps); cap is seconds (Girls and Hero caps are the usual gym caps, marked cap_note; people who don't finish score CAP + reps); rounds (when set) becomes the number of sets on each movement so athletes tick off rounds. Dropping a WOD into the program builder adds a block with its movements and the full workout as the block note.
